description: Land Title Settlement Department - Dehipagoda, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320241
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including details of land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and property rights. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land registration and title settlement processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
